title: Restructuring GitHub's bug bounty program
summary: GitHub announced restructuring changes to their bug bounty program, which was posted on their official security blog and discussed on Hacker News with moderate community interest.
problem_solved: This article discusses changes to how GitHub manages and rewards security vulnerability reporting through their bug bounty program.
why_valuable: Changes to major platforms' bug bounty programs affect thousands of security researchers and can influence the broader security researcher ecosystem.
